formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the allowance of `spender` over the owner's USDC.e (Polygon bridged USDC) to exactly `value`, and replaces any earlier allowance.
The allowance can be used by `spender` with transferFrom to move up to `value` USDC.e out of the owner's account; a maximum value is not treated as infinite and decreases with each spend.
The signature is valid only until `deadline` and uses the owner's current nonce, which increases when the permit is used.
Anyone can submit the signature; the owner pays no gas and moves no tokens when signing.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens" with the spender as a raw address, the max spending amount in USDC.e ("Unlimited" above 2^255), the valid-until date and the owner.

findings.title: Permit descriptor binds to domain version "2", but the contract verifies permits with version "1".
findings.evidence: UChildAdministrableERC20.sol, UChildERC20: `string public constant EIP712_VERSION = "1";` and `_setDomainSeparator(newName, EIP712_VERSION);` in initialize and updateMetadata. descriptor.json context.eip712.domain: `"name": "USD Coin", "version": "2"`. The domain name also comes from initialize (`newName`), and metadata.owner gives "USD Coin (PoS)", not "USD Coin".
findings.fix: Set the domain to the values the contract uses: `"domain": {"name": "USD Coin (PoS)", "version": "1"}`. Read `name()` on 0x2791…4174 to confirm the name.

findings.title: Permit domain uses salt = chainId instead of a chainId member; wallets may not bind it.
findings.evidence: UChildAdministrableERC20.sol, EIP712 library: `// keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,address verifyingContract,bytes32 salt)")` and `makeDomainSeparator` encodes `bytes32(chainId)` as the salt. The descriptor binds by `chainId: 137` in deployments.
findings.fix: Check that wallets match a domain that has `salt` and no `chainId` to deployment 137; add a test case with this exact domain.

findings.title: Permit format has no test case, so the wrong domain version and name are not caught.
findings.evidence: FORMATS.md: `cases: 0 (no tx)` for the Permit format.
findings.fix: Add a typed-message test that uses the real domain (name from `name()`, version "1", verifyingContract 0x2791…4174, salt 0x…89), with a finite value and a value of 2^256-1 to show the "Unlimited" message.

findings.title: Permit intent does not say that it replaces the existing USDC.e allowance for this spender.
findings.evidence: Permit._permit calls `_approve(owner, spender, value)`, which sets `_allowances[owner][spender] = amount;`. Descriptor intent: "Authorize spending of tokens"; no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Set USDC.e spending allowance".

findings.format: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
findings.title: Permit descriptor binds to domain version "2", but the contract verifies permits with version "1".
findings.reason: The only domain this contract checks against is built with version "1". It also puts the chain ID in a salt field, not in a chainId field. The descriptor binds to version "2", so it is tied to a domain the verifying contract never uses. The severity guide lists this as critical: "An EIP-712 domain or type that the verifying contract does not use". Neither the screen nor anything else in the descriptor fixes it. The claim about the name ("USD Coin" vs "USD Coin (PoS)") rests on storage set at initialize and can't be checked from the source, but the version mismatch is enough on its own.
findings.quote: UChildAdministrableERC20.sol (implementation 0xDD91…2226 behind proxy 0x2791…4174 per meta.json), contract UChildERC20: `string public constant EIP712_VERSION = "1";` and `_setDomainSeparator(newName, EIP712_VERSION);` in initialize/updateMetadata; library EIP712: `// keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,address verifyingContract,bytes32 salt)")` with `bytes32(chainId)` as salt; Permit._permit: `require(EIP712.recover(DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, v, r, s, data) == owner, ...)`. descriptor.json context.eip712.domain: `"name": "USD Coin", "version": "2"`.

findings.format: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
findings.title: Permit descriptor binds to domain version "2", but the contract verifies permits with version "1".
findings.reason: The version mismatch is real, but a signature over version "2" fails verification before any allowance changes; it does not authorize a hidden effect. The metadata owner label also does not establish the stored domain name.
findings.quote: contracts/137-0xdd9185db084f5c4fff3b4f70e7ba62123b812226/src/UChildAdministrableERC20.sol — UChildERC20: `string public constant EIP712_VERSION = "1";`; initialize/updateMetadata: `_setDomainSeparator(newName, EIP712_VERSION);`; _permit: `require(EIP712.recover(DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, v, r, s, data) == owner, "Permit: invalid signature");` precedes `_approve(owner, spender, value);`. descriptor.json — context.eip712.domain: `"name": "USD Coin", "version": "2"`. cases/0.json — screen.intent: `"Authorize spending of tokens"`; `"txHash": null`.
